name: Being Unique
overview: Scripture reveals that each person is uniquely created by God in His own image, reflecting His intentional design as seen in Genesis 1:27. From the womb, God intimately forms and knows us, making each life fearfully and wonderfully made, as celebrated in Psalms 139:13-14. Our distinctiveness is part of God's handiwork, likened to clay shaped by the potter in Isaiah 64:8, emphasizing our value and purpose under His sovereign care. This uniqueness is not only a gift but also a heritage to be honored, encouraging us to cultivate a good name and favor in the sight of God and others (Proverbs 22:1; Psalms 127:3).
